name: Base fee plus per-serving, with a minimum floor that does not bind
why: which bills the host only the SHORTFALL against a minimum, producing a
$150.00 subtotal. The notes describe something else entirely: '$99 plus the
cost of the amount of Kona's we serve (total minimum of $150 plus tax)'.
That is a base fee plus a per-serving rate, with $150 as a floor.
RATE_PER_SERVING also came back 0 despite 'SERVE & KEEP COUNT $4 12oz green
cups' and the explicit 'plus the cost of the amount of Kona's we serve'.
Reading the notes literally: 99 + (23 x 4) = 191. The $150 floor does not
bind because 191 > 150. So the subtotal should be $191.00, not $150.00 —
an under-bill of $41.00 before tax and fee.
CONFIRMED by the finance owner: 'in notes it is invoice'.
Root cause was the prompt, not the model. The HYBRID_SELLING_PLUS_MIN_GUARANTEE
section said 'Use when: Square or cash present AND host covers any shortfall'.
The driver's 'terminal 6' satisfied 'Square present' and 'total minimum of
$150' satisfied the rest, so the model matched the rule exactly. The adjacent
'do NOT use when the host pays by card' exclusion was unactionable, because
nothing told the model how to decide WHO paid — and the Selling signal table
listed 'Square' outright, pushing it toward guests.
open_questions: Does 'paid in full terminal 6' mean the host settled the full amount on the
card reader? If so, what figure was actually charged — Square is the record,
and if they were charged $150 the shortfall is a collection problem, not just
The engine has no floor concept outside the MG models:
INVOICE_BASE_FEE_PLUS_SERVINGS is base + units*rate with no minimum applied.
It bills correctly here only because 191 > 150. Had the driver served 5 cups,
99 + 20 = $119 would bill and the $150 floor would be silently ignored.
The notes say 'Multiply total by 1.04' — a 4% fee on the TAX-INCLUSIVE total.
The engine applies 4% to the pre-tax subtotal instead, so it lands at $210.10
where the note's arithmetic gives $210.56. A $0.46 gap, but it is systematic
across every CC event, not a rounding artifact.
